flows:
Navigate to https://www.jcrew.com/ then Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
At 320px width, assert the toggle hamburger menu control fits within the visible width.
Activate it without horizontal scrolling and verify Shop Women or another category control becomes available.

remark: analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'At 320px width, the toggle hamburger menu control fits
assert: At 320px width, the toggle hamburger menu control fits within the visible width.
click: Clicking the toggle hamburger menu in the top-left header
analyze: Another category control is available.
assert: Shop Women or another category control becomes available.

summary:
You asked to open the hamburger menu while using the 320-pixel-wide mobile view and without scrolling sideways.
The hamburger menu button was visible within the page width and was activated.
The opened menu showed category links, including “Shop Women” and “Shop Men,” confirming that a category control was available.
No sign-in, registration, or payment step was reached.
one_liner: opened the hamburger menu on J.Crew
